## mobile

### check-in: Monthly check-in

- Route: `/check-in` (auth: `required`, file: `apps/mobile/app/(app)/check-in.tsx`)
- Purpose: The monthly check-in on a phone (E12 S3), matching the web walk-through. One card per account in the engine's order, Update or No change (Keep this figure on a calculated loan), the one-press keep for the rest, then the summary. Each answer is saved with PUT /v1/snapshots/:month and checkIn true.

| Section   | Component                                             | Facts read                                                                 | Figures                       |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `cards`   | `apps/mobile/src/screens/CheckIn/CheckIn.tsx`         | `account-balance`, `balance-history`, `check-in-done`, `net-worth-choices` | `check-in-calculated-balance` |
| `summary` | `apps/mobile/src/screens/CheckInDone/CheckInDone.tsx` | `account-balance`, `balance-history`, `net-worth-choices`                  | `net-worth`                   |

### mobile-account-detail: Account detail

- Route: `/accounts/:id` (auth: `required`, file: `apps/mobile/app/(app)/accounts/[id].tsx`)
- Purpose: One account's page (E12 S6), also opened by flump://accounts/<id>, as web's. The balance or amount owed with the line that dates it, a joint account's whole beside the share, then its balance history with the chart, its summary and every month. Read only; editing opens the website until S8. An unknown id says so with Back to accounts.

| Section           | Component                                                 | Facts read                                                                                                   | Figures |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |

| `balance-history` | `apps/mobile/src/components/ChartFigure/ChartFigure.tsx`  | `account-balance`, `balance-history`                                                                         | -       |

### sign-in: Flump

- Route: `/` (auth: `public`, file: `apps/mobile/app/(app)/(tabs)/index.tsx`)
- Purpose: First screen of the Expo app (E12 S2a). Signed out, it shows the name, the tagline, Sign in and Create account (WorkOS AuthKit in the system browser sheet, PKCE) and the privacy and terms links. After sign-in it checks the account with GET /v1/user-profile and shows the Home tab inside the tab bar (E12 S4) with the monthly check-in row when one is due (E12 S3); restored without reaching Flump, Home shows the offline screen while the tabs stay, Not invited, the terms screen (403 terms_not_accepted sends the person to the website to agree)or the session-ended screen.
